test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Rights to vote in an election
solution: The correct answer is **"Suffrage."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Suffrage"** means the right to vote in political elections. (राजनीतिक चुनाव में मत देने का अधिकार; मताधिकार) • **Example: ***She wrote a book about the women’s **suffrage**__ movement in America.* • So, the correct answer is **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **'Potable' **means fit for drinking and is not related to the given group of words. ((पानी) पीने के लिए सुरक्षित) • **'Propaganda' **means information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote or publicize a particular political cause or point of view and is not related to the given group of words. ((राजनीतिक नेता, दल आदि के लिए समर्थन जुटाने में प्रयुक्त) असत्‍य या अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण जानकारी और विचार; मतप्रचार, दुष्‍प्रचार) • **'Orchard' **means a piece of land planted with fruit trees and is not related to the given group of words. (फलों का बाग़, फलोद्यान) 1d3:Te1a, The correct answer is **"Maestro."**
